title: Limiter.Allow · one customer's orders, one at a time

nodes.label: No window
nodes.role: The Limiter has no window for this customer. The next order creates one.
inputs: l.windows[customerID]: the customer's window, if there is one
now: the time of the order

edgeCases.text: A window is replaced only when an order arrives. Time passing alone changes nothing here; a window that has ended stays in the map until Forget removes it.
The comparison is >=, so an order that arrives exactly one minute after the window began already gets a new window.

nodes.label: Allowing
nodes.role: The customer has made at most 30 orders in this window. Each order is processed now.
inputs: w.count: orders of this customer in the window

transitions.when: an order 1 minute or more after w.start

nodes.label: Deferring
nodes.role: The customer is over the soft limit. An order is accepted but waits for the next tick of Handler.flushLoop.

transitions.when: an order 1 minute or more after w.start

rationale.text: A deferred order is still accepted. The soft limit only delays the customer, and the hard limit is what drops orders.

nodes.label: Blocked
nodes.role: The customer went over the hard limit. Every order is dropped until the window ends.

transitions.when: any order in the same window
an order 1 minute or more after w.start

edgeCases.text: The order that takes the count to 61 sets w.blocked and is itself dropped.
A blocked order returns before w.count++, so the count stays at 61 however many orders follow.

bubble.html: From order 31 on, Allow returns VerdictDefer. The order is kept and waits for the next tick.
Order 61 sets w.blocked. That order and every later one in the window return VerdictBlocked.
The first order that arrives a minute or more after w.start replaces the window, and the count starts at 1 again.

input.label: Orders
input.hint: Each character is one order of the customer. > means one minute passes.

edges.when: an order 1 minute or more after w.start
an order 1 minute or more after w.start
an order 1 minute or more after w.start

variables.name: now
variables.meaning: the time of the order, in seconds from the start of the example

variables.name: w.blocked
variables.meaning: true once the count went over the hard limit

outputs.name: verdict
outputs.meaning: what Allow returned for the last order
